title: 第9章 魏国大比第10章 陆玄合击败魏国天骄
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
这次秦天阳直接带着陆玄合穿越空间，再次出现时，已经位于魏国都城内了。
此时城内热闹非凡，万人空巷。
全都朝着一处比武场地赶去。
“快点！
快点！
今天是最后一天，也将会是最精彩的一场。
去晚了就抢不到好位置了”
“你觉得谁会夺得此次全国天才大比的冠军？”
“那还用说，肯定是金家少主金峰，其祖传的功法金阳耀天诀已被他修练至第四层，一身修为也已经达到元神境六重天。”
“我倒更看好荣国公家的世子，李云天。
这位世子在十五岁时，曾独自一人深入深山之中，追寻一伙马匪三天三夜，最终将其全歼，马匪首领当时是灵台七重天巅峰，而李世子却刚刚踏入灵台六重天的境界”
“黄家大小姐黄灵儿乃是此次大比中唯一的女子，巾帼不让须眉。
我看好黄灵儿，要是能娶到如此女子，就算让我拜大帝为师我也愿意！”
“你们难道忘了三皇子了吗？三皇子在十二岁时拜入了神霞宗，那可是仅次于圣地的顶级势力。
据传这位三皇子前不久刚刚突破至元神七重天，是这次大比中修为最高的人。”
秦天阳与陆玄合走在路上，耳畔不断传来路人的交谈声。
“怎么？你也想参加？”
看着陆玄合一脸跃跃欲试的神色，秦天阳开口道。
“师尊，弟子确实有这个想法，反正有师尊在，仇人跑不了。”
“之前弟子一直都是与妖兽战斗，但都是些神智未开的妖兽，实战效果远远不如人族。”

陆玄合眼中充满了战意，只想立刻去战个痛快。
“听这些人说，这四人中最强的是元神七重天，那么其他三人应该也差不了太多。
弟子元神三重天对战他们，刚好合适，毕竟弟子同境界一刀一个。”
“好小子，有志气，为师带你去会一会这所谓的四大天骄。”
二人来到了一处巨大的广场上，广场中间有一座巨大的擂台。
此时广场上人满为患，将擂台围了个水泄不通。
广场上方有一群人坐在贵宾席上，正中之人正是魏国皇帝魏凌空，此人看起来十分正派，一脸正气，但其眼中时不时闪过一抹阴狠之色。
魏凌空站起身开口说道：“今天的大比，正式开始。”
咻！
咻！
两道人影飞上了擂台，正是李云天与金峰。
李云天手持一把锋利的长刀，身穿盔甲，英武不凡。
而金峰身穿华袍，神色高傲，背负双手。
“哼！
content_en:
This time Qin Tianyang directly took Lu Xuanhe through space, and when he reappeared, he was already in the capital of Wei.
At this time, the city was very lively and the streets were deserted.
They all rushed towards a competition venue.
"Hurry up!
Hurry up!
Today is the last day and will be the most exciting one.
If you go late, you won’t be able to get a good seat.”
"Who do you think will win the national talent competition?"
"It goes without saying that it must be Jin Feng, the young master of the Jin family. His ancestral technique, Jin Yang Yaotian Jue, has been practiced to the fourth level, and his cultivation has reached the sixth level of the Yuanshen Realm."
"I am more optimistic about the eldest son of the Rongguo family, Li Yuntian.
When the prince was fifteen years old, he went deep into the mountains alone, chasing a group of horse bandits for three days and three nights, and finally annihilated them all. The leader of the horse bandits was at the peak of the seventh heaven of Lingtai at that time, but Crown Prince Li had just stepped into the realm of the sixth heaven of Lingtai."
"Huang Ling'er, the eldest daughter of the Huang family, is the only woman in this competition, and she is not inferior to other women.
I'm optimistic about Huang Ling'er. If I can marry such a woman, I would be willing to become the emperor's disciple! "
"Have you forgotten the third prince? When he was twelve years old, the third prince joined the Shenxia Sect, which was the top power after the Holy Land.
It was said that the third prince had just broken through to the seventh level of the Yuan Shen not long ago and was the person with the highest cultivation level in this competition. "
Qin Tianyang and Lu Xuanhe were walking on the road, and the voices of passers-by kept coming to their ears.
"What? You want to participate too?"
Seeing the eagerness on Lu Xuanhe's face, Qin Tianyang spoke.
"Master, this disciple does have this idea. Anyway, with Master here, the enemy cannot escape."
"Before, the disciples have always fought against monsters, but they were all monsters that were not yet conscious, and the actual combat effectiveness was far inferior to that of humans."
Lu Xuanhe's eyes were full of fighting spirit, and he just wanted to have a good fight right away.
“I heard from these people that the strongest of the four is from the seventh level of Yuanshen, so the other three should not be too different.
It was just right for the disciples from the third level of Yuan Shen to fight against them. After all, the disciples were in the same realm and each had their swords. "
"Good boy, if you are ambitious, I will take you to meet these so-called four geniuses."
The two came to a huge square with a huge arena in the middle.
At this time, the square was overcrowded and the arena was completely surrounded.
There was a group of people sitting at the VIP seats above the square. The person in the middle was none other than the Emperor of Wei, Wei Lingkong. This person looked very decent and upright, but there was a sinister look in his eyes from time to time.
Wei Lingkong stood up and said, "Today's competition has officially begun."

Li Yuntian holds a sharp long knife and wears armor, looking very heroic.
Jin Feng, on the other hand, was wearing a gorgeous robe, with a proud expression and his hands behind his back.
